Pau Hana Wednesday (Outta Bounds)

Honolulu, HI · Diamond Head / Kahala · Road

No-drop

Pau Hana Wednesday (Outta Bounds) is a road group ride in Honolulu, HI. It rolls every Wednesday at 4:30 pm from Triangle Park (Fort Ruger Park), east of Diamond Head. About 35 miles, fast, 18+ mph, regroup points and a designated sweeper. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 4:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: fast, 18+ mph, regroup points and a designated sweeper. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @outtaboundshawaii the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Pau Hana Wednesday (Outta Bounds) group ride

A fast after-work ride from Diamond Head out toward Hanauma Bay, Sandy's or Makapu'u depending on the season. The pace is 18-plus but the route is fixed, there are regular regroups and a sweeper so nobody is left behind. Refreshments back at the park.
